text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After Gentildonna finished her training, I 
glanced over toward a corner of the 
grounds—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*~~...! *pant*~~...! F-For real... 
this is so bad...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, Jordan-san. You must be tired.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... Gentile-san! You've seriously 
gotta hear this...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
They told me to pull tires for 10 laps, 
which is crazy~ Then they said doing 1 lap 
with a huge tire is fine, so I thought, 
"Score!"... but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nobody told me it'd be this gigantic! I've 
been pulling non-stop, but it won't budge 
at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, the tire in front of me is several 
times larger than the ones normally used.
choice_data_list:
Looks like it'd be tough to pull even for 
an Umamusume.

Looks like it'd be tough to pull even for 
an Umamusume, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I was just feeling like I hadn't had 
enough exercise. Would you mind if I 
pulled this tire?
choice_data_list: Huh!? You're gonna pull this now?
Huh!? You're gonna pull this now?

That would lead to overwork, so let's hold 
off this time.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I was just feeling like I hadn't had 
enough exercise. Would you mind if I 
pulled this tire?
choice_data_list: Huh!? You're gonna pull this now?
Huh!? You're gonna pull this now?

That would lead to overwork, so let's hold 
off this time.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. With this kind of weight, it seems 
just right for practicing late charges.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Or so I thought, but I'd like a bit 
more weight to it."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Would both of you mind getting onto the 
tire?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Adding more weight...? Gentil-san, you're 
an absolute demon...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna spent the day hauling an 
oversized tire until sunset.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In that case, could you book a reservation 
for me? I'll be using it for the next 
training session.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~...? After hearing that, do you 
actually feel like using it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I placed a reservation for an 
extra-large tire for Gentildonna.
